AnalysisMetric.description:
Operations supported by the decision intelligence module.
Rejects arbitrary or unsupported queries.

Phase 2 additions:
- OVERVIEW: snapshot-level summary (encounters, images, cameras, time coverage).
- SPECIES_ENCOUNTER_COUNTS: deduplicated encounter/species contributions.
- CAMERA_COMPARISON: per-camera/site encounter and species counts.
- DAILY_ACTIVITY: encounter counts grouped by calendar date.
- HOURLY_ACTIVITY: encounter counts grouped by hour-of-day (0-23).
- SPECIES_CAMERA_MATRIX: species × camera count matrix.
- EFFORT_NORMALISED_RATES: encounters per active camera-day.
AnalysisMetric.title: AnalysisMetric

description:
Request payload for analytical computation entry points.
Encapsulates metric selection, filtering parameters, timezone,
and optimistic concurrency revision checks.

species_ids.description: Filter for specific taxon identifiers. None means all species.
species_ids.title: Species Ids

camera_ids.description: Filter for specific camera traps. None means all cameras.
camera_ids.title: Camera Ids

site_ids.description: Filter for specific sites or clusters. None means all sites.
site_ids.title: Site Ids

start_time.description: Start of analysis time window (must be timezone-aware if given).
start_time.title: Start Time

end_time.description: End of analysis time window (must be timezone-aware if given).
end_time.title: End Time

analysis_timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier for diurnal/time-of-day bucketing.
analysis_timezone.title: Analysis Timezone

inclusion_policy.description: Whether to include unreviewed model predictions or only reviewed records.

expected_revision.description: Expected dataset revision to prevent calculating against stale data.
expected_revision.title: Expected Revision
